thread:
sam.w: Heads-up: onboarding Saffron7B vendor checkpoint. int8 looks clean but int4 shows repeating n-grams on longctx tests and occasional kv-index errors.

mai.l: any stack or repro?

sam.w: minimal repro attached:
```bash
python convert.py --in vendor/saffron7b.safetensors --out build/saffron7b.int4 --bits 4
./bench/run_longctx.sh --model build/saffron7b.int4 --len 2048
```
Observed: repeated phrases like "...and and and..." and log: `KVIndexError: computed index 1536 > max_rows 1024` on shard 1.

diego.r: suspects: 1) vendor left a high-id gap (reserved padding) in vocab, 2) our int4 packer assumes contiguous token ids when computing per-token Kv offsets (headstride * token_id). If vocab has holes you get out-of-range.

sam.w: I diffed vocabs. vendor has three reserved slots at the end and maps soft-hyphen to a high id. Quick fix: remap those reserved ids down and compact contiguous ids before packing.

mai.l: can we do a packer-side guard instead? i.e., sanity check before packing and fail convert with helpful message?

sam.w: yes adding `verify_vocab_compact()` that checks max_id == vocab_size-1 and returns mapping suggestions. Tested locally: remapping fixes kv error and removes repetition.

ops-bot: Deploy hold placed on saffron7b.int4 by @mai.l at 2025-01-12T09:20:00Z until conversion pipeline updated.

diego.r: next actions: 1) add vocab-compact check to convert CI, 2) run int4 vs int8 quality sweep overnight after remap, 3) add a unit test for kv-index calculation covering vocab holes.

mai.l: agreed. I'll own the CI gate. Thanks for the quick triage.
